method: Exact path and byte comparisons; SHA256 comparisons case-insensitive; each map.objects gzip path opened once, compressed SHA256 via Get-FileHash, decompressed in memory-streaming GZipStream and SHA256; no decompressed files written.
commands: PowerShell: compare source inventory files[] with raw-filemap files[] by exact path, bytes, and case-insensitive SHA256.
PowerShell: for each raw-filemap objects entry, Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 on the gzip object, then stream GZipStream decompression through SHA256.TransformBlock without writing extracted files.
